# Endpoint Pattern Search

Server endpoints whose `url.path` contains the pattern typed into the **EndpointPattern** variable above. Change the pattern to search different endpoints. Adjust the time window via the dashboard timeframe selector.

1.title: Distinct Endpoints
1.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes:500
| filter contains(lower(url.path), lower($EndpointPattern))
| filter span.kind == "server"
| summarize distinctEndpoints = countDistinctExact(url.path)
